battlefield/0.text: And when the cannon finally fires, the barrel kicks, the shell explodes, and the flag keeps waving because flags are professionals.

street/0.text: Every studio needs a prop department. Ours ships carts that roll through town on real spinning wheels, past houses with actual doors.

windmill-hill/0.text: The windmill turns when the script says turn. Not before. Not after. Determinism is a lifestyle.
